newsitem.title: USA: Amtrol Inc Q4 net income loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Amtrol Inc Q4 net income loss vs profit.

text.p: Amtrol Inc said on Thursday it posted a net loss of $1.3 million for the fourth quarter of 1996, compared to a profit of $0.5 million for the same period the year before.
Amtrol said its operating income for the fourth quarter of 1996 was $0.5 million, compared to $0.7 million for the fourth quarter of 1995.
For full-year 1996, net income was $7.4 million, compared to $9.1 million for 1995. Operating income for 1996 was $14.5 million, while it was $14.4 million in 1995.

Revenues for the fourth quarter of 1996 were $36.0 million, compared to $37.8 million for the same period the year before. For full-year 1996 revenues were $170.8 million, down slightly from $172.5 million for 1995.

Amtrol was purchased in August 1996 by affiliates of Cypress Group, a private investment firm, for $218.9 million. The company makes flow and expansion control technology used in water systems and heating, ventilating and air-conditioning products.
